plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-codex

Codex 式换窗压缩引擎——彻底替换官方 dsh-compaction-basic 的「LLM 摘要式压缩」。

## 机制

- 继承官方 `BasicCompactionEngine`，只覆写官方承诺的唯一子类钩子 `summarize()`；
- 摘要改为**纯确定性指针模板（零 LLM 调用）**：归档声明 + 恢复通道指引（history_search / history_read / notes read）+ 最近 model 检查点笔记全文（读 `~/.dsh/context-budget/notes/<sid>.jsonl`，只读）+ 被归档区首尾消息截断锚点；
- SummaryResult 走官方契约的模板分支（无 `llmStreamCall` 字段，官方注释点名 "template, remote, or other summarizer"），转录中 `compaction/summary` 事件显示 `provider: template, model: codex-rollover`；
- shadow 事务、replay 定价、工具配对平衡、并发锁、阈值自动触发（0.8×窗口，router-standard 为 0.55）、context-overflow 恢复、/compact（compactNow）全部原样继承。

## 装配

- 源码：`~/.dsh/plugins-src/dsh-compaction-codex/`（本目录），构建：`bash scripts/build.sh`（链接 dsh-install 类型依赖 + tsc 编译 src → lib）；
- profile 链：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-compaction-codex` 软链 + `package.json` link 依赖（防 pnpm install 剪掉）；
- 预设：6 个用户预设（code / code-guarded / code-lean / dshagent / designharness / router-standard）compaction 组中 `compaction-basic` 条目已替换为 `compaction-codex`（2026-09-29，各文件留有 `.bak-20260929` 备份）；
- 生效范围：仅新会话（预设热扫描；运行中会话保持旧代装配）。

## 约束与边缘

- 官方 `summarizeCompaction` 要求摘要帧 token 数 < 被 shadow 内容 token 数；本模板上限约 5K 字符（约 1.5K tokens），对数千 tokens 以上的压缩区安全；极小压缩区会按官方逻辑抛错并留在日志（不会静默）；
- notes 文件缺失/损坏时自动降级（省略检查点段），不阻塞压缩事务；
- 回滚：预设 yml 中把 name 改回 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（或恢复 .bak）即回官方 LLM 摘要，热生效（新会话）。

## 决策记录

- 2026-09-29 用户拍板：方案 A（子类替换）+ 纯 Codex 式（永不 LLM 摘要，无混合开关）；
- 否决方案 B（从零实现抽象 CompactionEngine：需重写 shadow 持久化/锁/配对平衡，收益零风险高）与方案 C（拆压缩组：长会话必撞上下文硬上限）。

plugins.description: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
# Balance Bucket · 余额水桶

**A little bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent.**

![Six bucket states: full, pouring, low, refilled, unreadable, and dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket/v0.1.1/docs/images/bucket-states.png)

一只挂在窗口角落的小水桶。**水是你的余额，漏出去的是正在花的钱。**

Version 0.1.1.

## What it does

- **The water level is your real balance.** It reads `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` with the same `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` that DSH chats with, so the bucket shows the money you actually have.
- **The water is two layers, because the money is.** Granted balance (赠送) floats on top of topped-up balance (充值). DeepSeek deducts the granted wallet first, so you watch the pale layer empty before the deep one moves.
- **The tap opens while money moves.** The stream and its droplets are proportional to the burn rate over the last three minutes — the tool for watching a `vibe coding` session eat your credit.
- **The bucket is as tall as the highest balance it has ever seen.** It starts full, and a top-up makes it taller rather than overflowing.
- **A failed read never lies.** If the balance cannot be read, the water stays where it was, the tap shuts, and the outline turns amber. It never empties the bucket to show an error.

Move it, resize it, tuck it away — right-click for settings, drag to reposition, arrow keys to nudge.

## Reading the bucket

| Look | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Pale layer on top | Granted balance (spent first) |
| Deep layer below | Topped-up balance |
| Blue water | Above 30% of the highest balance seen |
| Amber water | Between 10% and 30% |
| Red water, gentle wobble | Below 10% |
| Amber outline, no stream | The last read failed; the level is the last known one |
| Grey water, `—` | No API key configured, or the key was rejected |

Hover the bucket for the numbers, or open the settings panel for balance, granted/topped-up split, spent since start, added since start, burn rate, bucket size and the age of the last reading.

## Install

Package page: [dsh-plugin-token-bucket on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-token-bucket).

```text
dsh-plugin-token-bucket
```

Or pin this release:

```text
github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket#v0.1.0
```

The plugin needs the credential DSH already manages for chat. If the Models page has a working DeepSeek API key, the bucket works; if not, it says so instead of guessing.

## Privacy and runtime boundaries

- The API key is resolved through DSH's credential service on every poll and is **never** stored, logged, echoed in an error, or sent to the client half. The browser half never talks to the balance service itself.
- **One** outbound request exists: a read-only `GET` on the documented balance endpoint. No model calls, no telemetry, no listening port, no third-party service.
- Nothing about your conversations is read. This plugin subscribes to **no** session events, so it cannot see prompts, replies or tool output.
- Preferences and history live in the browser's local storage. The plugin never writes your DSH profile.

## Honest limits

- The burn rate is **estimated from balance deltas**, not from token counts: the balance moves in whole cents (¥0.01), so the reading is a rolling three-minute average rather than a per-request figure. It is deliberately not a billing statement.
- Polling is adaptive: every 5 seconds for two minutes after money moves, then 20 seconds, then once a minute while nothing happens. Change calls from other devices or tools are also visible, because they move the same balance.
- Prices, bonuses and the split between granted and topped-up balance are whatever the API reports. The bucket does not compute costs from a price list.
- Balances are read for one currency, preferring CNY.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
npm test
```

`preview/index.html` is a single offline file: open it in a browser, no server and no network needed. Its buttons fabricate balance samples, so every state can be inspected without an API key.

The Host half is bundled to `lib/index.js`, the strict browser/Host contract to `lib/remote.js`, and the browser half to `lib/client.js` by `pnpm run build`. Prebuilt files are committed so a Git install needs no build step.

## License

Code is [MIT](LICENSE). No third-party artwork is bundled: the bucket is drawn with CSS and one inline SVG.

plugins.description: DSH community plugin: ask any set of models to draw a pelican riding a bicycle on a schedule, then lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring — the pictures are the result. Pausable, with a settable interval.
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that runs a long-term
**model-quality probe** (降智监测) on a schedule, across **any number of
models**:

- **Pick your models** — the gear in the panel's top-right corner lists every model the
  configured providers report (live `/models` discovery, merged with the models
  in your DSH profile) and probes a multi-selected set, each model through its
  own provider and API key.
- **Scheduled drawing** — every 30 minutes (configurable) each selected model is
  asked to draw an **animated** *pelican riding a bicycle*: a single-file HTML
  page with an inline SVG whose motion is SVG declarative animation (`<animate>`
  / `<animateTransform>`).
- **No skills, no tools** — each run is a bare `chat/completions` request with
  no tool definitions and no agent loop, so the result measures the model
  alone, never your local skills.
- **Everything flat, nothing to click** — the main board is read-only: one band
  per model, its status and figures on the left (when its newest drawing landed,
  runs, average duration, how many came back without a drawing, and the failure
  reason) and every drawing it ever made on the right, all laid out at once —
  nothing collapsed, filtered, or hidden behind a click.
- **Run state in the header** — while probing: “n/m done”, which models are in
  flight, how long the slowest has waited (m:ss) and the timeout cap (m:ss), so a
  slow model and a stuck one are told apart at a glance.
- **One gear button** — the panel's own top-right corner opens a settings sheet:
  pick models, pause or retune the schedule, stop the pass, see one drawing
  bigger. The board below stays pure viewing, so nothing has to be clicked to be
  read. To probe **one** model, press 「单独检测」 on its band: one request for
  that model — and several bands can be probing at the same time.
- **Stop it, retune it** — that same sheet can **pause / resume automatic
  probing**, change the **interval** (1–1440 minutes), and **stop the pass that is
  running right now**: requests in flight are aborted, models that had not started
  are skipped without a request being sent. Pausing is written to
  `settings.json` immediately and survives a restart, so a plugin you only probe
  by hand never costs a token on its own.
- **Bounded history** — keeps the newest N drawings **per model** (10 by
  default); the cap never gets divided between the models you are probing, and
  two providers serving the same model id keep separate histories. Same prompt,
  same model, over days: degradation shows up as worse structure, refusals
  (saved and badged 「未检出 SVG」), or latency growth.

## Install

From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pelican-watch
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

## Choosing models

The gear in the panel's top-right corner opens the settings sheet, which lists
**every provider route registered in DSH** — the signed-in 「DeepSeek 账号」
account, the official API-key route, and any third-party provider you configured
— grouped by the display name DSH uses, each with the models it advertises. Tick
any number of models and **Save models**: from the next cycle on each selected
model draws its own picture and gets its own band on the board.

**The board shows exactly the selected models**, in the order they were saved —
a band never jumps around. Unticking a model and saving **deletes its drawings**:
anything the board cannot show is only invisible dead weight on disk, and these
probe drawings are meant to be re-drawn anyway. The save toast says how many went.

A model id is not unique: the signed-in account and a third-party provider can
both serve `deepseek-flash`. A band is therefore a **provider + model** pair, and
it carries the provider's display name next to the model name — two providers
never share one band, nor one another's drawings.

The plugin never touches key material: calls go through DSH's model service
(`ctx.llm`), which resolves the credential itself. That is why the
account-backed provider (no API key at all, just a signed-in account) can be
probed here, and why any provider that works in DSH works here. A provider that
cannot list its models (not signed in, expired key) still appears, with the
reason attached.

That selection lives in `dir/settings.json` and is what the scheduler uses;
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the first run. The same file holds
two knobs that decide what you spend, both changeable from the panel's gear
without touching any config file:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoEnabled` | `true` | Off disarms the timer at once (`nextRunAt` goes empty); only the manual “probe now” then spends anything, and the choice survives a restart. |
| `intervalMinutes` | follows `config.intervalMinutes` (30) | Changing it in the panel re-arms the countdown immediately — no restart. |
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the very first run. At most 12
models are probed per cycle — `concurrency` of them at the same time (3 by
default), one drawing each.

## Speed and timeouts

- **Models run in parallel** (3 at a time by default), so one slow model no
  longer delays the others: every drawing is written to disk the moment it
  arrives and shows up in the panel within seconds.
- **Each request has its own timeout** (`timeoutSeconds`, default 600). A model
  that exceeds it is reported as `超过 N 秒没有返回` on its own band instead of
  hanging the whole pass. Reasoning models can genuinely be slow — measured
  against one provider: `qwen3.7-max` ~52s, `deepseek-flash` ~121s (15k of those
  completion tokens were reasoning), while `glm-5.3-flash` sometimes exceeded
  4 minutes.
- **A timeout or HTTP error is not a drawing**: nothing is saved and it does not
  count as a drawing, because that is an infrastructure fact rather than model
  behaviour. A model that *answers* without an SVG (a refusal) is saved and
  marked `没出图` — that is the signal worth looking at.
- `maxTokens` is not sent by default: reasoning models spend tens of thousands of
  completion tokens before they draw, and a tight ceiling would truncate the SVG
  instead of speeding anything up.
- **A truncated drawing is reported as such**: when the answer stops at the
  output ceiling (an `<svg>` without its closing tag), the band says
  「回答被截断（已输出 N tokens）：SVG 没有画完，多半是达到模型的输出上限」 instead of the
  vague 「未检出 SVG」, and the half-drawn page is not kept as history. Raise
  `maxTokens` in the config to give a verbose model more room.

## Configuration

Defaults match the usual profile setup; override any of them on a
`pelican-watch` row in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: pelican-watch
  config:
    # initial selection (the panel's picker wins once used)
    provider: deepseek-account           # a DSH provider route; account by default
    model: deepseek-flash                # model id
    # targets:                           # optional: seed several models at once
    #   - { provider: deepseek-account, model: deepseek-flash }
    #   - { provider: taotoken, model: glm-5.3-flash }
    intervalMinutes: 30                  # drawing cadence
    maxImages: 10                        # drawings kept per model (1–100; ≈5h at 30min)
    timeoutSeconds: 600                  # per-request ceiling (5–3600); lower it if a model hangs
    concurrency: 3                       # how many models are probed at once
    # maxTokens: 8192                    # optional; unset by default (see below)
    dir: ~/.dsh/pelican-watch            # where drawings are saved
    runOnStart: true                     # draw once ~8s after boot
    # temperature: 0.7                   # optional; omitted by default
    # prompt: …                          # only if you must change the benchmark
```

The benchmark prompt is delibe

plugins.description: Offline HAR diagnostics with minimal evidence for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# HAR Triage

Offline network evidence for DeepSeek Harness. Find failed and slow browser requests without handing the agent your URLs, cookies or response bodies.

浏览器网络排障插件：读取本地 HAR，生成可回查原始请求索引的离线诊断报告。默认不把网址、请求头、Cookie、参数值或正文带进报告和 AI 工具结果。

![Synthetic HAR diagnosis: signals, source indexes and timing evidence](docs/report-demo.jpg)

The screenshot uses the bundled synthetic scenario, not real browser traffic.

## What it does

- Reads an existing HAR 1.2 capture; never records traffic, sends requests, or changes the capture.
- Groups requests into endpoint aliases, highlights HTTP 4xx/5xx, unavailable responses, slow requests and long waiting phases.
- Produces a self-contained HTML report: signals → request row → measured timing phases. Filters, pagination and source locators work offline.
- Returns at most 20 evidence entries to the agent, with a count of omitted evidence. The full numeric projection stays in the local JSON/HTML files.

Request #43 corresponds to `log.entries[42]` in your original HAR. Endpoint aliases deliberately do not reveal names. Keep the original capture private and use its index to look up the actual request locally.

## Install in Harness

Node 22.19+ is required. Install the prebuilt bundle into your chosen profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-har-triage/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-har-triage-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile YOUR_PROFILE --dump-config
```

The configuration should contain the `har-triage` row. Start that profile, put your HAR inside its session workspace, and ask:

> Inspect capture.har with har_triage. Save reports in a new har-review directory. Explain the measured evidence and cite the original HAR entry indexes. Do not guess root causes.

Tool arguments:

```json
{"input":"capture.har","outputDir":"har-review","slowMs":2000}
```

The tool uses Harness filesystem and sandbox services. It requires write permission to create the reports and refuses input/output paths outside the session workspace. Existing report files are never overwritten. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-har-triage`.

## Try without Harness

The CLI and analysis/report modules use Node built-ins only. From a source checkout:

```sh
node src/cli.js capture.har --out new-report-directory --slow-ms 2000
```

Open `new-report-directory/report.html`. The output directory must not exist. The original capture is unchanged.

For a reproducible synthetic example:

```sh
npm run demo
```

This creates a new directory under `artifacts/` with a deliberately synthetic capture and its report. It is not evidence of real browser traffic or real users.

## Evidence, not root-cause claims

`503` means the capture records a server-error response. `status: 0` means it did not record a valid HTTP response. Neither identifies a failing service, proves CORS, or proves an expired token. A high wait/TTFB share is an observation, not proof that the backend or database is slow.

Start offsets include submillisecond differences and are expressed in relative milliseconds. Absolute source timestamps are never included in the report.

Unknown phase timings and byte sizes remain `-1`, displayed as “Unknown.” TLS is part of the HAR connection timing and is not added a second time. Contradictory phase durations are flagged; the report hides misleading proportions.

Ollama's [`application/x-ndjson` streaming responses](https://docs.ollama.com/api/streaming) are classified as JSON. This is a MIME-based content category, not validation of the response body; model output remains excluded from reports.

## What is retained and removed

Retained: source entry index, sequential endpoint alias, controlled method/status/content classes, relative offsets, numeric durations/sizes, and fixed diagnostic codes. Aliases group the same method/origin/path within one capture; query strings and fragments do not affect grouping.

HTTP method identity is case-sensitive: `GET` and `get` receive separate aliases. Only the allowlisted uppercase methods receive named display values; all other method tokens appear as `OTHER`. Private method tokens are used only for grouping and are not included in reports, tool evidence or report ID hashes.

Removed: complete URLs including origins and paths, query values, headers, cookies, request/response bodies, page titles, initiator data, IP addresses, absolute timestamps, extension fields, raw error text, and the original file digest. The report ID hashes only the retained projection. Arbitrary source strings are not copied to reports or tool evidence.

This is a minimal diagnostic projection, **not** a scrubbed HAR, an anonymization guarantee, or a replacement for reviewing an artifact before sharing it. Status patterns, sizes, timing, request counts and grouping can still identify an application. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Limits

- HAR JSON only: version `1.2`, UTF-8, at most 16 MiB and 10,000 entries. Invalid supported entries fail with fixed errors rather than silently truncating the evidence.
- HTTP and HTTPS requests are analyzed. Other protocols are excluded and counted. Missing timing/size values are retained as unknown; a valid request URL, start timestamp, duration, status and response content object are required.
- Synchronous bounded analysis: cancellation is checked before parsing and between entries, not an interruptible worker. The slow threshold defaults to 2,000 ms and is configurable per call.
- Reports are created exclusively. If HTML creation fails after JSON creation, the JSON is retained and the tool reports the partial result; retry using a fresh destination.
- No upload, traffic replay, header inspection, body analysis, automatic source lookup, or edits to the original HAR.

## Development and validation

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

48 tests passed on Node 24 and 26. They cover actual CLI subprocesses, controlled output and failure text, input limits, phases, original-file preservation, and real Cordis tool dispatch/filesystem/sandbox/Loader integration. `smoke:host` is a real service composition, not a CLI profile boot or a live-LLM test.

The packed bundle was separately installed through the actual CLI into fresh temporary Profiles on Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, then booted with `runProfile` and exercised through `har_triage`. Source bytes were unchanged; output omitted the synthetic canary; overwrite and workspace-escape attempts were refused. HMR was disabled only in those temporary Profiles. The alpha host emitted three unrelated Typert activation warnings; rc.2 did not. No LLM or real credentials were used.

Browser checks covered status filtering, signal-to-request navigation, correct source locators, no console errors, and a 390-pixel layout without page-level overflow. The demo and regression captures are synthetic; real-user usefulness is not yet validated.

## Related tools

[net-debug](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/net-debug) is an existing Harness HTTP client with history, replay and HAR export. [harlite](https://github.com/brucehart/harlite) already offers extensive HAR analysis, SQL, waterfall and HTML reporting. This plugin does not replace those tools: its narrower purpose is a Harness-native, no-external-binary, allowlisted evidence path for agent-assisted debugging.

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: DSH native plugin: audit GitHub repos for fake stars, stargazer bot farms and hollow codebases using CMU StarScout heuristics, plus static supply-chain and sensitive-permission inspection.
plugins.readme_text:
# @suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor

```
⚠️ 本仓库是**自动生成的发布镜像**，每次发布都会整体覆盖 `main`。
**唯一事实来源 / single source of truth:** [Suxeca/dsh-plugin → packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin/tree/main/packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor)
请勿在本仓库提交代码或 PR —— 改为修改源仓库中的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，本仓库的内容会被下一次发布覆盖。
```

**本仓库只发布可安装产物**（`lib/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`locale/`、`package.json`），**不含 `src/` 与 `tests/`**：审计器要检测的那些标记（安装钩子名、宿主进程 API、越狱口令等）在本仓库的产物中一律由运行时拼装生成（源仓库 `src/tokens.ts`），所以任何静态扫描都不会在本仓库里读到它自己的检测表 —— 否则它会扫到自己、把自己判成 CRITICAL（F 级），并让安装门禁对使用者误报。源码与唯一事实来源仍在源仓库。

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生插件：基于 CMU StarScout 启发式指标审计 GitHub 假星 / 水军 / 空壳仓库，并对 DSH 插件做供应链投毒与敏感权限静态预检。

## 安装 / Install

```bash
dsh plugin add github:Suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor
```

无需构建：`lib/` 已预编译随仓库发布（prebuilt）。包名 `@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`，由 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明装配。

## 功能 / What it does

- **假星与互动比率审计** — Fork/Star、Watcher/Star 比率异常检测，含大仓（>50k stars）通知疲劳校准与豁免模型。
- **空壳与脉冲刷量** — 高星但代码体积 < 30 KB 的空壳仓库、活跃跨度不足 2 天的增星脉冲、0-Issue 异常增星（维护者关闭 Issues 时豁免）。
- **点星水军抽样** — 并发抽检最新 Stargazers 的 Profile，识别「三无空白号」与「新注册闪电水军」。
- **供应链投毒预检** — 经 GitHub Raw CDN 零配额静态拉取 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`，识别高危安装钩子（远程下载、`eval`、混淆、凭据窃取）与 DSH 敏感权限（密钥服务注入、插件管理服务、宿主进程 API、工具执行前置钩子）。
- **安装拦截门禁** — 通过工具执行前置钩子（pre-execution hook）监听插件安装动作与 `bash` 中的 `git clone` / `npm install github:...`，命中风险时弹出 DSH 原生审批卡片。

## 配置项 / Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: repo-auditor
      name: '@suxeca/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor'
      config:
        token: ""               # GitHub PAT（可选）
        sampleSize: 5           # 水军账号抽样数量
        enableInstallGate: true # 安装拦截门禁开关
```

| 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | `string` | `""` | GitHub Personal Access Token（可选）。留空时按四级顺序自动探测：`config.token` → DSH 凭据服务 → 环境变量 `GITHUB_TOKEN` → 本地 `~/.bashrc` / `~/.env` / `.env`。未鉴权时受 60 次/小时配额限制，鉴权后为 5000 次/小时。 |
| `sampleSize` | `number` | `5` | 水军账号抽样数量；仅在仓库一阶指标可疑（评分 < 85）时才触发抽样，用于保护 API 配额。 |
| `enableInstallGate` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否启用工具执行前置钩子（双轨安全拦截门禁：星标信度低 或 供应链/敏感权限中高风险 → 弹卡审批）。 |

紧急逃生通道 / escape hatch：在命令前加环境变量 `SKIP_REPO_`＋`AUDIT=1`（拼接后即为跳过标记）可跳过安装门禁。

## 出处与致谢 / Attribution

启发式指标来自 CMU 论文 **"Six Million (Suspected) Fake Stars in GitHub: A Growing Spiral of Popularity Contagion, Suspicious Promotion, and Unwanted Projects"**（StarScout）— [arXiv:2412.13459](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13459)。本插件是 DSH / Cordis 架构下的原生重实现，与论文作者无隶属关系。

## 构建与来源 / Build & source

本仓库为预编译产物，安装无需构建。源码与开发文档位于 [Suxeca/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/Suxeca/dsh-plugin) 的 `packages/dsh-plugin-repo-auditor`；发布流程见该仓库的 `scripts/release-auditor.sh`。

## 许可 / License

MIT License — 见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。该文件由发布脚本从源仓库根目录自动复制，与 `package.json` 的 `license` 字段保持一致。

plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作浏览器与电脑：以插件形式装配 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp，附一键依赖安装、macOS 系统权限引导与 MCP 连接自检。
plugins.readme_text:
# Browser & Computer Control (`dsh-browser-computer`)

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

Turns "let DSH drive a browser and a computer" into a plugin wired through a single installation.
The MCP capabilities are declared by two rows in `cordis.patch.yml` — `playwright-mcp`
and `peekaboo-mcp`. That part follows the official "configuration-only bundle" recipe
(`templates/mcp` + `references/mcp-bundle.md`): MCP wiring alone requires no Host or Client
entry file. This package additionally provides Host and Client entries for health checks,
repair, and the status UI. See the activation steps below.

Once activated it automatically runs "check environment → install missing dependencies →
check permissions → open the permission panels that need attention", and the UI is just a
status line plus one **Repair** button. It **never writes profile config** (that is the
official plugin manager's exclusive job) and **never changes system permissions** (it only
opens the relevant System Settings panel for you to click).

## What it wires

| Row | Provider | What you get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playwright-mcp` | `@playwright/mcp` | Real-browser control driven by accessibility snapshots and stable refs: navigate, click, fill, tabs, screenshots, network, cookies/storage |
| `peekaboo-mcp` | `@steipete/peekaboo` | Read/write the macOS accessibility tree, screenshots, real mouse and keyboard input (macOS only) |

`command` is resolved at load time via `!!js` to the absolute `npx` that sits next to `node` —
no machine-specific path is hard-coded, and it does not rely on the minimal `PATH` a
Finder/Dock-launched app receives (a bare `npx` cannot be resolved there, so the server dies
silently).

## Install and activation

Add any of these specs on DSH's official Plugins page. For profiles that allow CLI
management, use the commands below. If the Electron App exclusively owns the desktop
profile, use its plugin manager instead of trying to manage that profile from the CLI.

```bash
# 1) from npm (recommended; specify @version for reproducible installs)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-browser-computer

# 2) straight from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:fegnze/dsh-browser-computer

# 3) local development (points at this directory; refresh/restart requirements still apply)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<absolute path to this repo>
```

**After installing you must fully quit and reopen the DSH App.** Historical measurements:

- The two MCP rows appear in the config layer immediately after install (`Config.listConfigs`
  shows `playwright-mcp` / `peekaboo-mcp`), but they are **not** materialised into
  `mcp__playwright__*` / `mcp__peekaboo__*` tools in the running session, and no MCP child
  process is spawned.
- The Host half's JavaScript is held by the process module cache: without a restart,
  activation still reports errors from the previous revision.
- The official mcp-bundle recipe itself ends with "install, then call
  `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` to verify".

After the restart, verify by asking the model to call `browser_computer_repair`, by running the
slash command `/browser-computer repair`, or by calling an MCP tool directly (for example
`mcp__playwright__browser_navigate`).

The Client half (the section on the plugin page) needs **one more step: refresh the page**.
Only after the App restarts does the boot graph include this plugin's client entry, so an
already-open page has to be refreshed once to pick it up.

## What it does on its own

Plugin activation (install, or App restart) runs `repair` once, without you clicking anything:

1. **Check environment** — Node / npx / browser binaries / dependency-package caches
2. **Install missing dependencies** — `npx -y <package> --version` warms playwright-mcp and
   peekaboo-mcp; **already-cached packages are never re-downloaded**
3. **Check permissions** — Screen Recording / Accessibility (`--no-remote`, so the state
   belongs to the DSH App's own process chain)
4. **Guide permissions** — if anything is not granted, open the matching System Settings panel
   (it only opens panels; it never grants anything)

The whole pass is idempotent and runs in the background; a failure in any step only writes one
log line and **never breaks activation**. Set `autoRepairOnStart: false` to turn it off.

## UI: a status line and one button

The UI lives on **this plugin's own detail page** (official slot `plugins.detail.section`), not
in the host Settings page — this is the plugin's own health check, not a host preference. The
`Section` component returns `null` for other plugins' subjects (it only renders when
`subject.kind === 'bundle' && subject.pkg.name === <package name>`), so it never leaks onto
other plugin pages.

There are exactly two things:

- **A one-line status** plus a status card (environment / the three permissions / MCP
  connection), read once automatically when the page opens (read-only, no network)
- **One "Repair" button** → `POST /api/repair`: installs missing dependencies, opens the panels
  that need authorisation, and finally verifies the connection

Both endpoints pass two fences: a custom intent header (which blocks cross-site simple
requests) and `connection.admit` (the Host/Origin fence plus browser authentication). The UI
does not `require` any Harness Client package; controls and styles are its own and reference
only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens.

In a previous development environment, a Client change did **not** need an App restart:
editing `src/client.js` rebuilt the graph and the live page picked it up (the plugin's entry
appeared in `plugins.detail.section`'s occupants). Refresh-free updates require an active
`pnpm run dev:web` watcher in the same checkout. Without verifying that watcher, rebuild the
affected Web artifacts and refresh the existing page; automatic updates are not promised.
Host changes require a full restart.

## The two actions

| Command | Tool | Side effects | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/browser-computer check` | `browser_computer_check` | none (no network) | local dependencies, macOS permission state, profile wiring conflicts |
| `/browser-computer repair` | `browser_computer_repair` | installs packages, may open panels | install missing dependencies → check and guide permissions → verify the MCP connection (`verify: false` skips that) |

With no argument it runs `repair`. The tool surface is deliberately just these two: tool
schemas are a permanent context cost.

## macOS permissions: the pitfall that wastes half an hour

TCC (System Settings → Privacy & Security) has **no** "Event Synthesizing" switch. That is
Peekaboo's name for a capability it derives; it actually hangs off Accessibility:

| Name in the report | Where in System Settings | What it affects |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Screen Recording | Privacy & Security → Screen Recording | screenshots, window enumeration |
| Accessibility | Privacy & Security → Accessibility | accessibility-tree reads/writes, background clicks |
| Event Synthesizing | same place; it opens automatically once Accessibility is granted | synthetic keyboard, foreground pointer actions |

Two things you must know:

1. **The grant target is the DSH App**, not your terminal. The plugin uses `--no-remote` so
   Peekaboo reports permissions from the local execution environment, which attributes the
   state to the DSH App's process chain. Going through a Peekaboo Bridge/daemon instead is a
   different grant *and* spawns a resident process.
2. **Restart the DSH App after granting.** A TCC change does not necessarily take effect for an
   already-running process.

## Security boundaries (read before installing)

- This plugin's `computer` row passes `--allow-foreground`: **without it, real clicking and
  typing are impossible**. If you only need background accessibility work, delete that single
  argument from `cordis.patch.yml` to reduce the privilege.
- Playwright MCP ships `browser_run_code_unsafe`, which the vendor labels "RCE-equivalent".
  Page content is untrusted input; do not point it at your daily-driver browser profile first.
- The plugin never touches permissions, so the ceiling

plugins.description: Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents with a reopened-file check.
plugins.readme_text:
# WordCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![WordCraft Use — editable business documents](assets/official-logo.png)

> Draft, lay out, and deliver editable Word documents from an agent session, with real section structures, native tables, and a reopened-file check before handoff.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](#positioning)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-16-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP servers](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20servers-1-6E56CF)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Skills](#skills) · [MCP tools](#mcp-tools) · [Limits](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

`wordcraft` turns source material into an editable document rather than a text dump: it collects the real facts, fills a section and field structure, lays the result out with native headings, tables, page numbers, and headers, then reopens the file and checks what the reader will actually see. It wraps the native WordCraft engine in sixteen skills and one embedded editor.

This is an installable development candidate. Production promotion is blocked, embedded host synchronization is not accepted, and short one-page samples do not prove that arbitrary long documents paginate correctly.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin ID | `wordcraft` |
| Display name | WordCraft Use |
| Version | `0.1.0-dev.20261018.5` |
| Stage | Installable development candidate, production promotion blocked |
| Native engine | WordCraft 0.7.0 via `wordcraft-cli` |
| Marketplace | `wordcraft-marketplace` |
| License | Apache-2.0 |

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Codex is the host with recorded evidence. Other hosts are not accepted.
- Node.js 24 or newer is required by the embedded editor. The distributed package already contains the editor build; no Rust toolchain and no `npm install` are needed at runtime.
- Native file workflows use `wordcraft-cli`, which this plugin does not install. Query the installed version and command schema before running a recipe.
- The first Git-based launch needs network access or an existing verified editor cache. Complete release ZIPs can start offline from bundled assets.
- Windows Git installs need long-path support: `git config --global core.longpaths true`.

### From the plugin marketplace

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins
codex plugin add wordcraft@full-aigc-plugins
```

The repository also ships its own marketplace metadata (`wordcraft-marketplace`) pinned to `v0.1.0-dev.20261018.5`. Restart the host, open a new task, and state the document type and the real source material.

## Quick start

1. Say what to produce and from what: “Write this week's report from these work notes; mark anything missing as pending confirmation.”
2. Let the agent choose the document skill and fill real fields. Templates describe sections, required fields, and native layout operations; they are not empty outlines with a new title.
3. Ask for a new editable DOCX plus a review PDF. Templates are designed for new documents, not for overwriting an existing file.
4. Reopen the DOCX, check heading levels, cell-by-cell table content, and column counts, then compare against the PDF page.

```text
Meeting minutes: turn these notes into minutes with decisions and action items.
Weekly report: summarize progress, blockers, and next week's plan.
Proposal: produce a project proposal with phases, deliverables, and owners.
Quotation: build a line-item table with quantities and decimal prices; do not infer tax.
```

Direct CLI form for file tasks, one method per argv argument; verify text afterwards with `wordcraft-cli text out.docx`:

```bash
wordcraft-cli run --cmd 'text.insert={"text":"Body text"}' --save out.docx
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Meeting minutes | `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Decisions, owners, and action items in an editable table |
| Weekly report | `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Completed, in-progress, blocked, and next-step sections kept separate |
| Project proposal | `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Goals, phases, deliverables, and planned dates |
| Requirements document | `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Numbered requirements with observable acceptance conditions |
| Acceptance report | `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Expected versus actual results, with failed items preserved |
| Business letter | `wordcraft-business-letter` | Recipient, subject, confirmed facts, and requested reply |
| Commercial quotation | `wordcraft-quotation` | Native line-item table, per-line amounts, and a checked total |
| Research and resume layout | `wordcraft-research-report`, `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Structured sections, figures, references, and a compact layout |
| Long-form structure | `wordcraft-toc-handbook`, `wordcraft-illustrated-guide`, `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Updatable table of contents, captioned figures, and portrait body with landscape appendix |
| Revision and playbooks | `wordcraft-document-comparison`, `wordcraft-document-style`, `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Text and structure diff, unified styles, eight checked recipes |

## Skills

### Document templates

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-meeting-minutes` | Build minutes from discussion, decisions, and action items |
| `wordcraft-weekly-report` | Build a weekly report from work records, progress, and next-week plans |
| `wordcraft-business-proposal` | Build a proposal with goals, approach, plan, and delivery |
| `wordcraft-requirements-document` | Turn interviews or drafts into numbered, testable requirements |
| `wordcraft-acceptance-report` | Record acceptance criteria, measured results, and open issues |
| `wordcraft-business-letter` | Draft a business letter from recipient, subject, and confirmed facts |

### Commercial and layout

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-quotation` | Compile explicit line items into a native table and verify decimal totals |
| `wordcraft-research-report` | Lay out abstract, sections, figures, tables, and references |
| `wordcraft-resume-layout` | Lay out experience and outcomes in a compact resume |
| `wordcraft-document-style` | Unify headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables across a document |

### Long-form and comparison

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-toc-handbook` | Produce a handbook with an updatable table of contents |
| `wordcraft-illustrated-guide` | Produce a guide with images and captions |
| `wordcraft-landscape-appendix` | Combine a portrait body with a landscape matrix appendix |
| `wordcraft-document-comparison` | Compare two versions for textual and structural differences |

### Session and playbooks

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `wordcraft-editor` | Open the real editor in an MCP Apps host or host browser and share one workspace session |
| `wordcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Eight recipes for project briefs, SOPs, release notes, decision tables, letters, training decks, and two-column briefs |

## MCP tools

`.codex-plugin/mcp.json` starts one stdio server, `wordcraft-editor`, from `ui/bootstrap.mjs`. The adapter adds three stable tools and passes through the pinned engine's document tool catalog.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace`; the first call binds the workspace |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for the same session when the host has a built-in browser |
| `editor_status` | Report whether the editor actually attached and is ready

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏余额栏：自动显示官方账号余额，点击在 DSH 内查询用量
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Sidebar Balance Bar

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-balance-bar` is a community desktop plugin (not an official DeepSeek product), compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2. It adds a persistent top-up balance bar in the native `sidebar.footer.action` slot, above the existing account entry. It does not replace that entry, modify core code, inject positioning DOM, or start an additional service.

## Behavior

- Uses Host `deepseekAccount.getBalance()` and the current login, without reading credentials or passing them to the frontend.
- The Client reads every 10 seconds; the Host queries upstream on demand, with a minimum interval of 30 seconds and coalesced concurrent requests. Reads pause while the page is hidden and resume with a check when the window returns, still respecting the cache interval. This is not real-time server push. Clicking the bar uses the same `globalThis.dshPlatform.open('usage', bounds)` bridge as the native button to embed the official usage page inside DSH, without opening an external browser. The plugin provides a back button, viewport-size synchronization, and cleanup on close; the native bridge still manages credentials. The entry is disabled when the desktop bridge is unavailable or the account is signed out. This bridge depends on the current desktop version and must be reverified after upgrades.
- Top-up and promotional balances are not added together. The main bar shows the top-up balance; the tooltip shows the promotional balance and update time. An empty wallet displays `—`, not a fabricated zero balance.
- The Host listens for account changes and clears its cache, using generation checks to discard in-flight responses from before an account switch. The frontend reflects sign-out no later than the next successful read. Network failures clear the frontend amount; upstream Host failures retain the old amount with an explicit stale indicator.
- Collapsing the sidebar hides the balance bar; the original account entry remains clickable. All requests, subscriptions, timers, styles, and registrations are cleaned up on plugin unload. The upstream service does not accept cancellation parameters; already-started requests can only have their results discarded after completion.
- The local `/myspace-balance-bar/api` route restricts requests to loopback, a valid Host, same-origin Origin/Fetch Metadata, and a custom request header. Only local browsers are supported; CORS is not provided.

## Development and installation

Install the npm package `dsh-balance-bar` through the DSH plugin manager. No API key is required: it uses the official account currently signed into DSH. Only the desktop profile is supported; do not install it in the Web profile.

No build is required; the native ModuleLoader Client ships in the package. For development, install `link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-balance-bar`. Disabling the bundle removes the balance bar. Restarting DSH after an upgrade is recommended to avoid running old code from the Host module cache.

Disable or uninstall the old local package `myspace-dsh-balance-bar` before installing this package. Do not enable both at once: they share route and slot identifiers.

Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-balance-bar.

```sh
npm test
node --check src/client.js
```

Verification covers balance caching, request coalescing, failure states, sign-out and account switching, discarding in-flight responses on unload, and request-origin validation. The balance bar and embedded official usage page have been verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop. The centered loading spinner has been checked in code, but its loading phase has not been captured separately on the real application. Account sign-out is covered by isolated tests; acceptance testing does not sign the user out.

## Limitations

- Balances are polled, not pushed in real time; statistics on the official usage page may be delayed.
- The native embedded page uses the current desktop bridge; navigation in an ordinary browser is not supported.
- Loading shows only a centered spinner, without explanatory text. It does not rotate when the system prefers reduced motion.
- This plugin does not collect account credentials, upload balances, or provide top-up operations.

## Trusted publishing

[The publishing workflow](<.github/workflows/publish.yml>) uses GitHub Actions OIDC without storing an npm token. Run it manually on `main` with the reviewed full commit SHA in `expected_sha`. `dry_run` defaults to true; set it to false only for an approved new-version publication. The workflow rejects a mismatched SHA before publishing.

In the npm package's Trusted Publisher settings, configure GitHub Actions, owner `fegnze`, repository `dsh-balance-bar`, and workflow `publish.yml`, leaving Environment empty. The npm account owner must complete two-factor authentication for this configuration; committing the workflow alone does not establish authorization.

## License

MIT; see [LICENSE](<LICENSE>).

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 里所有未声明 reasoningEfforts 的模型自动补上 high / xhigh / max 三档的 Host 插件：零运行时依赖、无构建步骤、幂等，写入走 configEditor 正常路径并刻意放在 HMR 事务之外。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-default-reasoning-efforts

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 Host 插件：
**所有没有声明推理等级的模型，自动获得 `high / xhigh / max` 三档。**

配套 [dsh-codex-effort-slider](https://github.com/Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider) 用：
滑条能不能滑到某档，取决于**模型有没有那一档**；本插件负责把缺的档位补上。

## 为什么必须改配置（而不是在界面上"造"三档）

档位不是 UI 变出来的，是 **Host 侧 LLM 适配器报出来的模型能力**：

```
profile 配置 reasoningEfforts
  → dsh-llm-pi-ai: resolveModelReasoning() → pi-ai thinkingLevelMap
  → getSupportedThinkingLevels() → reasoningInfo() → ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo()
  → 模型目录（浏览器）→ 官方菜单「推理等级」那一行 / 滑条刻度
```

配置里没写 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型，解析结果是 `reasoning: false`
（手写声明的模型不在 pi-ai 内置目录里，没有可继承的能力）。后果是双重的：

1. 模型目录里没有档位 → 官方菜单**连「推理等级」那一行都不渲染** → 滑条无处可挂；
2. 就算客户端硬塞一个档位，`dsh-llm` 在 `resolveCallWithInfo()` 里也会以
   `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` **直接拒掉这次请求**。

所以唯一端到端成立的做法是把档位写进 provider 配置，让适配器自己认。

## 它做什么

`apply()` 里做一次**幂等、可重入**的配置补齐：

1. 等目标 entry（默认 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`）出现在 `configEditor` 里（退避重试约 30 秒）；
2. 读它的**有效配置**，找出 `providers.<route>.models[]` 里所有 `reasoningEfforts` 未声明的模型；
3. 用官方 `ctx.configEditor.edit()` 写回 profile patch
   （走 Loader 正常路径：校验 → 原子写 → 失败回滚；**YAML 注释保留**）；
4. `ctx.emit('llm/adapters-updated')` —— 已连接的浏览器会**立刻重拉模型目录**，不用刷新页面。

**幂等**：没有任何要补的模型时，一个字节都不写，也不会触发重载循环
（档位已经等于目标档位的模型会被跳过，所以第二次运行是彻底的 no-op）。

**热装即可生效**（不用等重启）：写配置这一步被刻意放在 **HMR 事务之外**执行。
原因是实测踩到的坑 —— `configEditor.edit()` 内部是 `hmr.runExclusive()`，而
`runExclusive` 一旦发现自己已经处在一次 HMR 事务里就直接拒绝
（`HMR transactions cannot be nested`）；插件热装/热启用时 `apply()` 恰好跑在
这样一次事务里，而且 hmr 用的是 `AsyncLocalStorage`，上下文会顺着 `setTimeout`
一路传下去 —— 所以"晚一点再写"根本逃不出去（第一版插件就是这么**静默失败**的）。
现在照官方 `hmr.watchConfig` 的做法用 `AsyncLocalStorage.exit()` 把写入放到事务外，
拿不到就退回普通调用；写入被拒时还会退避重试（约 37 秒），绝不静默吞掉。

## 默认规则

| 模型状态 | 默认行为 |
|---|---|
| 没写 `reasoningEfforts` | **补上 `{high: high, xhigh: xhigh, max: max}`** |
| 写了 `reasoningEfforts: false` | 不动（显式声明"这个模型没有推理"，视为用户的明确选择） |
| 写了别的档位表 | 不动 |
| 写了但恰好就是这三档 | 不动（保证幂等） |

## 可选配置

`$DSH_HOME/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts/config.json`（**不存在就用内置默认值**，改完下次检查即生效）：

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" },
  "targets": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"],
  "providers": [],
  "includeDeclared": false,
  "dryRun": false
}
```

| 键 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `enabled` | `false` = 完全不动手（插件照常加载，只跳过补齐） |
| `levels` | 要补的档位表：键只能是 pi-ai 的七档名 `off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max`，值是**线上拼写**（`off` 允许 `null` = 不发送该参数） |
| `targets` | 要管的 entry **包名**（默认只动 pi-ai 适配器；别的适配器 schema 不同，别乱加） |
| `providers` | provider route 白名单（`[]` = 全部） |
| `includeDeclared` | `true` = 连已声明（含 `false`）的模型也覆盖成 `levels` |
| `dryRun` | `true` = 只在日志里说会改什么，不写文件 |
| `pollSeconds` | **兜底自检**间隔（秒，默认 30，`0` = 关掉）。见下 |

### 新加的模型什么时候会被补上

| 时机 | 会不会补 |
|---|---|
| **每次 DSH 启动** | **一定**。启动那次检查会扫全部模型，缺档位的一个不落 |
| 运行中在**设置页新增模型** | **会**，最多 `pollSeconds`（默认 30 秒）内 |
| 运行中**手改 `cordis.patch.yml` 文件** | 要等下次启动（实测：这个环境里 HMR 的配置监视没把文件改动送进运行中的 Loader；反正下次启动会补） |
| 插件被禁用（`enabled: false`） | 不补 |

为什么要有 `pollSeconds` 这个自检：宿主确实会发 `llm/adapters-updated` /
`settings/document-updated` / `hmr/reload` 这几个事件（插件都订阅了），
但"事件有没有送达"不在本插件的控制范围内 —— 与其把正确性押在上面，
不如按固定间隔自己看一眼：有活就干，没活就是一次纯读的 no-op。
30 秒一次的读取成本可以忽略，换来的是"新加的模型一定会被补上"这个确定性。

配置非法时会退回内置默认值并在日志里说明原因（不静默）。

## 回执：它到底做了什么

每次检查的结论会写到 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts/status.json`
（只在结果变化时写，不是每次事件都动磁盘）：

```json
{
  "at": "2026-10-14T01:41:46.342Z",
  "pid": 23388,
  "enabled": true,
  "targets": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"],
  "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" },
  "status": "patched",
  "matchedEntries": ["llm-pi-ai"],
  "changedModels": [{ "provider": "local", "model": "step-5-preview", "levels": { "high": "high", "xhigh": "xhigh", "max": "max" } }],
  "wrote": true,
  "error": null
}
```

`status` 取值：`patched`（补了）/ `no-change`（没活可干）/ `dry-run` / `waiting-entry`
（目标 entry 还没出现）/ `read-failed` / `write-failed` / `crashed` / `disabled`。
**排障第一步就是看这个文件** —— 它比宿主日志好找，也比"猜插件跑没跑"可靠。

## 安装

```powershell
# 面板：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 填仓库地址或本目录绝对路径
# 或命令行（非 desktop profile）：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:junjundesk/dsh-default-reasoning-efforts
# 本地开发时直接链本目录：
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"<本目录的绝对路径>"
```

零运行时依赖、无构建步骤（只用 node 内置模块），解开就能装。

## 测试

```powershell
node test/plan.test.mjs      # 43 项断言：档位规范化 / 配置规范化 / 补齐规划 / HMR 事务逃逸 / 端到端接线
```

测试里有一份**假 `configEditor`**：`edit()` 会把新配置落到 entry 上，所以"第二次运行必须
一个字节都不写"这件事是被真断言守着的，而不是靠肉眼。其中一项是**回归测试**：用真的
`AsyncLocalStorage` 模拟 hmr 的事务上下文，并让 `edit()` 在事务内直接抛
`HMR transactions cannot be nested` —— 它复现了第一版插件的真实故障，也守着修复不被改回去。

## 已知边界

- 只改 `providers.*.models[].reasoningEfforts` 这一个字段，其它字段原样保留。
- 补的是**声明**，不是"让模型真的会思考"：端点是否接受 `xhigh`/`max` 由上游决定，
  与你在同一个 provider 里给别的模型写的那套拼写保持一致。
- `targets` 默认只含 pi-ai 适配器。别的适配器（如官方 DeepSeek）有自己的固定档位表，
  强行补档位可能让请求被上游拒掉。
- 卸载/关掉后，已经写进 profile patch 的 `reasoningEfforts` **不会自动删掉**
  （那是你的配置，插件不替你回滚）——想恢复就把那几行删掉。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: Bounded, git-committable project memory for DeepSeek Harness: five whitelisted .ai/ files with capacity budgets, structured entries, tiered retention, and a stable prompt section.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-project-memory

**项目级有限容量长期记忆**：把跨会话的项目认知（决策、约束、任务、坑、事实）存进工作区的 `.ai/`，可以提交进 git、跟着仓库走，并且**有容量上限**。

> English: dsh-project-memory gives DeepSeek Harness a bounded, git-committable memory layer for a project: five whitelisted Markdown files under `.ai/` hold decisions, constraints, unfinished tasks, known bugs, and durable facts. Entries are human-readable one-line records with stable ids, updated in place, behind hard character and byte ceilings with age-based coarsening that never rewrites a conclusion. A stable, frozen prompt section injects a prioritised summary once per session, and a machine-wide layer under `$DSH_HOME/project-memory/` carries conclusions shared by every project. The package makes no model calls and runs no background jobs: writes come from the `project_memory` tool or the human `/memory` command. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory` and verify with `node scripts/check.mjs`.

harness 本来就有两样东西：`AGENTS.md`（规则）和会话史书（session-recall，**会话级**）。缺的是中间那层 —— **跨会话沉淀下来的项目认知**：定过什么决策、哪些任务没做完、踩过哪些坑。没有它，换个会话或换台机器，这些就散了。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell） | ✅ 已实测（Windows 11） | `dsh` 是 `dsh.cmd`/`dsh.ps1` 垫片；`node scripts/check.mjs` 会自动找到垫片旁边的 npm 包并直接执行其 JS 入口（Node 不能直接 spawn `.cmd`）。`scripts/*.sh` 需要 Git Bash 或 WSL，不想装就用 `.mjs`。 |
| macOS（zsh） | ✅ 设计支持 | `DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`；`scripts/*.sh` 与 `*.mjs` 都可用。本机未实测，代码只用 Node 标准库的跨平台 API。 |
| Linux（bash/zsh） | ✅ 设计支持 | 同 macOS。 |

- **Node**：`package.json` 的 `engines` 要求 `>=22`（本机用 24.19.0 验证）。
- **DSH**：`peerDependencies` 全是 `*`，**没有锁定版本**。实际需要已安装 `dsh`（0.2.x；本文按 0.2.1-rc.2 验证），且该 profile 能加载第三方 bundle —— 也就是 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add …` 可用。

## 安装

1. 确认前置条件（PowerShell 与 zsh 命令相同）：

   ```bash
   node --version    # 需要 v22 或更高
   dsh --version     # 需要已安装 DeepSeek Harness
   ```

2. 把插件装进 profile（两个系统命令完全一样，`web` 换成你要用的 profile，如 `headless`）：

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory
   ```

3. **重启 dsh host**。插件在 host 启动时 import，`dsh plugin add` 只改磁盘上的依赖，不会热加载。完全退出当前进程再启动，例如：

   ```bash
   dsh web
   ```

   刷新 GUI 页面**不够**。

4. 在**你的项目**里初始化记忆。先进入项目目录再启动 dsh，然后在会话里运行：

   ```text
   /memory init
   ```

   `.ai/` 建在**用户项目**里，不是插件目录：workspace 根是当前目录往上最近的 `.git`（没有 `.git` 就用启动目录），所以从子目录启动也会写到仓库根。第一次 `project_memory write` 也会创建缺失的 `.ai/`，`/memory init` 只是把五个模板文件一次建好。

5. 可选：建立跨项目的全局层（放在 `$DSH_HOME/project-memory/`，不进任何项目仓库）：

   ```text
   /memory init --global
   ```

### 两个系统唯一的路径差异

| | Windows（PowerShell） | macOS / Linux（zsh/bash） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_HOME` 默认值 | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`（写作 `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh`） | `~/.dsh` |
| 全局层目录 | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\project-memory` | `~/.dsh/project-memory` |
| 项目 `.ai/` | 用户项目根目录下，与操作系统无关 | 同左 |

`dsh plugin add` 本身由 dsh 处理 profile 位置，两边命令一致；`DSH_HOME` 设了就以它为准。

### 从本地路径安装（开发用）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-project-memory
node scripts/dev-link.mjs
```

`dsh plugin add <本地路径>` 装的是 `link:` 依赖，Node 的 ESM 解析会顺着符号链接走到仓库真实路径，从而找不到 profile 里的 harness 包。`dev-link.mjs` 把这些包链接进本仓库的 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`（Windows 用 junction，macOS/Linux 用目录符号链接）。git 安装不需要这一步。

## 验证

```console
$ node scripts/check.mjs
ok:   project-memory is in the composed tree
ok:   project-memory-section is in the composed tree
ok:   tool-project-memory is in the composed tree
ok:   command-project-memory is in the composed tree
ok:   the prompt section row is mounted
note: no global layer yet — create it with /memory init --global (optional, cross-project memory)
```

- 检查其他 profile：`node scripts/check.mjs headless`（默认 `web`）。
- 如果已经建过全局层，最后一行会变成 `ok:   the global layer exists (C:\Users\you\.dsh\project-memory)`（macOS 为 `/Users/you/.dsh/project-memory`）。
- 任何一行 `FAIL:` 都会让退出码为 1。`npm run check` 是同一个脚本。
- shell 版（macOS/Linux，或 Windows 的 Git Bash/WSL）：`bash scripts/check.sh web`。
- 单元测试：`npm test`（`node --test`，全部用假文件系统，不碰真实磁盘、不调模型）。

## 配置

**这个包没有用户级 YAML 配置键。** `cordis.patch.yml` 里的四行只有 `id` 和 `name`，没有 `config:`；行为由代码常量决定。你会编辑的 YAML 就是这四行本身 —— 它们故意分开，是为了只挂其中一部分：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: project-memory
      name: 'dsh-project-memory/service'
    - id: project-memory-section
      name: 'dsh-project-memory/section'
    - id: tool-project-memory
      name: 'dsh-project-memory/tool'
    - id: command-project-memory
      name: 'dsh-project-memory/command'
```

- 只留前两行 = 纯存储 + 注入，不注册模型工具。
- 去掉 `command` 行 = 没有 `/memory` 命令；去掉 `tool` 行 = 模型不能用 `project_memory` 读写。

不想动包内文件时，用 profile 自己的 patch 层（dsh 会在所有 bundle 层之后应用它）按 `id` 关掉某一行。例如只关模型工具、保留存储/注入/`/memory`，编辑 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
# 按 id 关掉 bundle 插入的某一行
- id: tool-project-memory
  disabled: true
```

要彻底不挂载，则编辑上面这份 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 列表（升级/重装会覆盖包内文件）。

影响行为的常量（**不是 YAML 键**，改动需要改源码；`ProjectMemory` 构造函数的 `{ fs, globalRoot }` 是给测试/嵌入用的，不是用户配置）：

| 行为 | 默认值 | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 五个文件软配额 | `project.md` 4000、`decisions.md` 6000、`tasks.md` 5000、`bugs.md` 5000、`memory.md` 4000 字符 | `lib/entries.js` `MEMORY_FILES` |
| 硬上限（五件合计） | 24000 字符 / 65536 字节 | `lib/entries.js` |
| 整理目标 | 19000 字符 | `lib/entries.js` |
| 项目层注入预算 | 12000 字符 / 4000 估算 token | `lib/entries.js` |
| 全局层注入预算 | 4000 字符 / 1000 估算 token | `lib/service.js` |
| 详情粗化档位 | ≤7 天全留；7–30 天留最后 2 条；>30 天只留结论 | `lib/entries.js` |
| 全局层目录 | `$DSH_HOME/project-memory`，`DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`（Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`） | `lib/service.js` |
| 工作区根 | 从 cwd 往上最近的 `.git`（文件或目录都算） | `lib/store.js` |
| `project_memory` 的 `read` 单次上限 | 8000 字符 | `lib/tool.js` |
| prompt section 顺序 | 9500 | `lib/section.js` |

唯一相关的环境变量是 `DSH_HOME`：它只影响全局层位置，不影响项目里的 `.ai/`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-project-memory
```

然后**重启 dsh host**（同上，插件在启动时加载）。

插件不会带走这些磁盘内容：

- 用户项目里的 `.ai/`：五个 Markdown 文件、`.gitignore`、`.local/` 内部状态、每次写入保留的一份 `*.bak` 恢复副本。它们是你的项目文件，插件被卸载也不会删。
- 全局层 `$DSH_HOME/project-memory/`（默认 `~/.dsh/project-memory/` 或 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\project-memory\`）。
- 已经提交进 git 的 `.ai/` 历史。

确认不再需要时手工删除：

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .ai
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\project-memory"
```

```bash
# macOS / Linux
rm -rf .ai
rm -rf ~/.dsh/project-memory
```

如果 `.ai/` 已经提交，用 `git rm -r .ai` 删除并正常提交；若设置了 `DSH_HOME`，全局层在 `$DSH_HOME/project-memory`。

## 排错

| 症状 | 原因 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但会话里没有 `project_memory` 工具、也没有 `/memory` 命令 | 插件在 **host 启动时** import；`plugin add` 只改依赖，不会热加载 | 完全退出 dsh 进程再启动（如 `dsh web`）。刷新 GUI 页面无效。 |
| 改了插件代码（或 `git pull` 了插件）行为没变 | host 进程里是 ESM 模块缓存，旧模块不会因文件变化重新加载 | 重启整个 host 进程。本地 `link:` 安装同样要重启，单测不受影响。 |
| `dsh plugin add` 在私有网络 / 公司代理后失败（拉 GitHub 超时、证书错误） | pnpm 需要能访问 GitHub（或配置的 registry/代理） | 设置 `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` 后重试；或 `git clone` 到本地，用 `dsh plugin --profile web add <本地路径>` 再跑 `node scripts/dev-link.mjs`。 |
| 记忆看起来是空的：注入没有内容、`/memory status` 全是 0 | 项目根还没有 `.ai/`；读取不会创建模板 | 在项目里运行 `/memory init`（或让模型第一次 `project_memory write`）。注意 workspace 根是最近的 `.git`，从子目录启动也会写到仓库根。 |
| 写入报权限错误（EACCES/EPERM），或提示文件在准备期间变了 | `.ai/` 所在目录只读（只读 checkout、容器只读挂载、ACL），或读与写之间文件被外部改动 | 修权限或换可写工作区；外部改动先 `git diff` 看一眼再重试。插件不会静默覆盖别人的改动。 |
| `node scripts/check.mjs` 报 `FAIL: no such profile: …` | `DSH_HOME` 指向别处、profile 名拼错，或装插件与检查用了不同 profile | 检查 `$env:DSH_HOME`（Windows）/`echo $DSH_HOME`（macOS），默认 profile 是 `web`。 |
| 容量满了，写入被拒绝 | 五件合计达到 24000 字符 / 65536 字节；结论永不自动删 | `/memory check` 看整理计划，`/memory compact --apply` 粗化旧详情，或 `/memory forget --id <id> --apply`。注意 `forget` 默认只预览，忘加 `--apply` 会“看起来没生效”。 |

## 设计

### 五个文件，都在 `.ai/`

| 文件 | 装什么 | 软配额 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project.md` | 项目概况、当前阶段 | 4000 字符 |
| `decisions.md` | 已定的决策 | 6000 |
| `tasks.md` | 未完成的任务 | 5000 |
| `bugs.md` | 已知的坑与缺陷 | 5000 |
| `memory.md` | 其他长期事实 | 4000 |

硬上限 **24000 字符 / 65536 字节**（五件合计），整理目标 19000。软配额是**可互借**的：它决定容量紧张时先粗化哪个文件，不决定写入是否合法。

`.ai/.local/` 放程序内部状态，初始化时自动写进 `.ai/.gitignore`。

### 条目格式

人可读、可手改、`git diff` 看得懂：

```text
- YYYY-MM-DD [id=稳定标识] [status=active|done|resolved|superseded] [kind=constraint|decision|task|bug|fact|history]: 当前完整结论
  - 可选嵌套详情
```

- 同一个 `id` 再次写入是**原地更新**，不是追加重复条目。
- 围栏代码块里的示例**永远不会**被当成条目 —— 所以文件里可以

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: choose which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-workspace-capabilities 按工作区选择可用的技能（skill）和 MCP 服务器的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单里多一项 **技能与 MCP**，点击后弹出窗口，勾选该工作区要用的技能和 MCP 服务器。取消勾选的项目不会提供给该工作区的会话，从下一轮对话起生效，无需重启。 ## 插件界面 支持在工作区里面设置skill与mcp，可以有效的规避工具上下文占用或其他特需需求场景 ## 行为 - **技能**：取消勾选的技能从会话的技能目录中消失，`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 都无法再加载它。 - **MCP**：取消勾选的服务器，其全部 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话（含子代理）隐藏；服务器本身保持连接，其他工作区不受影响。 - 默认全部启用。保存的是「禁用列表」，所以之后新装的技能、新加的 MCP 服务器默认可用。 - 选择按工作区路径保存在 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-capabilities.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/workspace-capabilities.json`）： ```json { "version": 1, "workspaces": { "/path/to/project": { "disabledSkills": ["some-skill"], "disabledMcpServers": ["github"] } } } ``` ## 安装 先退出桌面版 DSH NEXT，然后： ```bash ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" "/Applications/DSH NEXT.app/Contents/MacOS/DSH NEXT" --expose-internals "/Applications/DSH NEXT.app/Contents/Resources/app/lib/plugin-cli.js" desktop add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-capabilities ``` 重新打开 DSH NEXT 即可。卸载把 `add github:...` 换成 `remove dsh-workspace-capabilities`。本地开发可改用 `add link:/path/to/clone`。 命令行版（Web profile）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fleey/dsh-workspace-capabilities ``` ## 实现说明 - 工作区「…」菜单是写死的两项（重命名 / 删除），没有扩展 slot，所以浏览器端通过 DOM 注入：菜单弹出时复制「重命名」一行并插入，点击后关闭菜单并打开对话框（`lib/client.js`）。 - 技能注册表没有过滤钩子，Host 端包装了注册表的 `collectFresh`，按查询的 `cwd` 去掉禁用的技能；注册表缓存本来就按 `cwd` 区分（`lib/index.js`）。 - MCP 通过 `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny })` 对每个会话屏蔽工具，工具集合或选择变化时自动重算。 - 接口：`GET /dsh-workspace-capabilities/state?workspaceId=`、`POST /dsh-workspace-capabilities/save`，走 Host 自己的请求鉴权。 ## 限制 - 依赖 DSH 0.2 内部结构（侧栏菜单 DOM、技能注册表 `collectFresh`）。DSH 升级后若这些变化，菜单项可能不出现或技能过滤失效（会在日志中警告），MCP 过滤走的是公开 API。 - 被禁用的 MCP 服务器若返回了服务器指令（instructions），该文本仍会出现在系统提示词中；只是工具不可用。 - 列表中的技能按当前工作区路径发现；只在其他 agent preset 中挂载的技能可能不显示。 - 本插件只能**隐藏**技能，不能启用在来源处被停用的技能。例如在 dsh-skills-manager 中停用的技能仍会出现在列表里，但会标为「来源已停用」且无法勾选；需先在技能管理器中重新启用。 ## 测试 ```bash npm test ```

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的模型fallback链插件：以更智能、更人性化的方式配置fallback链。当主模型撞限流、额度耗尽，或者5xx超时的时候自动向下改派模型，回合不中断。设置页可视化编排：拖拽排序、按计费或者上下文窗口排序候选模型、失败模型自动冷却、管理多条链的停用和启用。零依赖、无构建步骤、默认不介入任何请求。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-fallback

简体中文 | [English](README-en.md)

本插件是给 DeepSeek Harness 的每个主模型配一条**有序候选列表**：请求失败且错误类别命中你勾选的触发条件时，由链上的下一个模型接替这次请求。回合不会中断，并在会话里注明改派原因。

通常的应用场景是，你接了几个免费鸡蛋渠道，或者多个小额度、有限额的渠道，跑长任务的时候模型经常会因为各种原因撞墙终止任务。有了model-fallback后能够在一定程度上解决这种问题。

除此之外，我还花了很多时间调整用户界面和使用体验，如果在外观和手感上有什么不顺手的地方也欢迎提交issue。

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-blue.svg)](#构建)
[![build step](https://img.shields.io/badge/build%20step-none-lightgrey.svg)](#构建)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-green.svg)](https://github.com/yn2aa/dsh-model-fallback)
[![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-beta-orange.svg)](#当前状态)

- **编排界面**：设置页 → 模型回退链。多条链集中在一个清单里管理，拖拽排序，按计费倍率或上下文窗口排序候选。
- **触发条件**：限流（TPM/RPM）、额度耗尽、HTTP 5xx、超时与网络错误，都是可勾选的开关。
- **安全默认**：没有链时插件不介入——不拦截、不改派，也不产生任何标注。一个文件就能做到随时停用，不需要重启。

安装见[安装](#安装)。想先看效果的话，[配置回退链](#配置回退链)中有完整的界面说明。

## 为什么需要它

有三条在本机实测确认的事实：

1. **内核没有跨模型 fallback。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry` 只对**同一个 provider** 重试，`provider` 原样透传；它的 `Config` 甚至显式拒绝 `retryPolicy` 之外的键。
2. **本地网关也没有。** `127.0.0.1:8326` 的 `POST /v1/chat/completions` 经 `parseModelRoute` 切出唯一一个 `{provider, model}`，只调用一次 `llm.stream()`，没有别名表、模型组、也没有回跳。
3. **实际遇到的报错不在本机。** 逐字节扫描 121 MB 的 `app.asar` 与整个 profile `node_modules` 后确认：`litellm`、`model_group`、`No fallback model group`、`raccoon-4eb26a`、`node03-rg` **全部零命中**。那串报错由商汤上游服务端生成并透传；限流发生在服务端。

因此唯一能做的是：**在本地这一跳失败时，改派到另一个模型。**

## 接管点与两条缝

插件挂在内核的两条 waterfall 上，而不是网关层：

```
会话请求 → Agent Loop
             ★ agent/request        —— 决定「下一次尝试用哪个模型」，必要时换成候选
           → ctx.llm.stream() → 渠道适配器 → 上游
             ★ agent/request-error  —— 唯一的失败观测点，决定「要不要重试」
           ↺ 重试回到同一 turn/step，再次经过 agent/request
```

- **为什么要两条缝**：`agent/request` 能换模型但看不到失败；`agent/request-error` 能看到失败但**载荷里没有 model**（只有 `provider`）。所以插件在 `agent/request` 上记下「实际发出去的是哪个模型」，失败时才归因得到是哪条链该动。
- **为什么不用 `agent/request-error` 的默认行为**：内核默认下游返回 `undefined`，循环就抛错结束回合；插件必须自己返回 `{kind:'retry'}`，重试才会发生——也才有下一次 `agent/request` 去改派。
- **会话请求走 `ctx.llm` 不经过 8326 网关**，所以只做网关层修不到会话里的报错。网关层（供其它用 base URL 调 8326 的工具）不在本插件范围内。

## 安装

> **桌面端限制（重要）**：桌面端启动前会扫描 profile 目录树，**只放行 dsh 自己在 `.dsh-module-fallback` 下生成的链接**。出现任何其它符号链接或目录 junction 会直接拒绝启动：
>
> ```
> PROFILE_UPGRADE_REQUIRED: offline dependency migration is not yet available
> ```
>
> 所以**不要用 `link:` 安装，也不要创建 junction**；用应用内插件管理器，或放置一个**真实目录**。

### 一键安装／卸载

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install\install.ps1     # 复制真实目录 + 登记依赖与 bundle
pwsh -File .\install\uninstall.ps1   # 上面那一步的完整逆操作
```

两个脚本默认按 `$DSH_HOME`（未设置则 `~/.dsh`）定位 profile，与插件自己的 `lib/store.js` 同一套规则。安装位置不同就传参：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install\install.ps1 -ProfilePath '<你的 profile 路径>'
```

### 用 `dsh plugin` 命令行安装

`dsh` CLI 有一个 `plugin` 子命令，本质是把参数透传给 profile 里的 pnpm：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add dsh-model-fallback
```

**但它装不进桌面 profile。** `--profile desktop` 被硬拒：

```
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

`desktop` profile 只归 Electron 应用自己管——它会重写 profile 的 `package.json`、自己维护 bundle 列表，CLI 插手会和它打架。所以这条命令**只对 headless 之类的自定义 profile 有意义**；桌面端请用上面的脚本或应用内插件管理器。

`dsh` 不是全局命令时，可以这样调（用 Electron 本体当 node 跑 CLI），把下面的 `<DSH 安装目录>` 换成你自己的 DSH 安装位置：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
& '<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe' `
  '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js' --help
```

### 从零开始的完整流程

本包**没有构建步骤**（见下节），所以「构建→装载→看到分区」就是下面这四步。假设 profile 目录为 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/`：

1. **放置真实目录。** 把本包整个复制到 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-model-fallback/`，必须带上 `lib/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`package.json`（`README.md` 可选）。   
2. **登记依赖。** 编辑 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json`，在 `dependencies` 中加入 `"dsh-model-fallback": "0.1.0"`（版本号跟随本包 `package.json` 的 `version`，**不要写成 `link:`**）。   
3. **登记 bundle。** 在同一个 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾追加 `"dsh-model-fallback"`。  
4. **重启 DSH。** 首次装载需要重启一次（替换已安装包的 JS 同样必须重启，见下表）。重启后打开 **设置 → 模型回退链**，应能看到该分区。

**不要再往 `cordis.patch.yml` 添加条目。** 被 `dsh.profile.bundles` 引用的包，其自带的 patch 层会自动生效；两处同时注册会报 `duplicate loader entry id`。

装好后启动日志里应出现自述行，用来把「装了但没生效」和「装了且在待命」区分开：

```
[model-fallback] loaded — data dir <DSH_HOME>/model-fallback, 0 chain(s)
[model-fallback] no chains configured — not intervening in any request
[model-fallback] runtime armed — settings API at /api/model-fallback
```

### 重启要求

| 改动 | 是否需要重启 |
| --- | --- |
| 装载／启用／禁用该插件（host 侧） | 否，实时生效 |
| **替换已安装包的 JS**（`lib/*.js`） | **是，必须重启** |
| 仅客户端 bundle（`lib/client.js`） | 否，但需 `pnpm run dev:web` 在跑才自动重建；否则刷新页面 |

替换已装载包的 JS 必须重启，是 ESM 模块缓存造成的：缓存以 URL 为键，文件改写不会让它失效，运行中的进程会继续执行内存里的旧代码。

客户端的实时改动依赖 `pnpm run dev:web` 重建 bundle；不跑该 watcher 时**刷新页面**即可看到改动。

## 配置回退链

打开 **设置 → 模型回退链**，页面自上而下是：**回退链管理区**（最顶部）、可用模型清单、候选编辑面板、冷却中的模型、最近改派记录。

后三块只在**按下某条链的「编辑」按钮后**才出现，并且只属于那一行链——没在编辑时，页面只剩管理区、冷却与历史，不会占用版面。

### 建一条链

1. **可用模型清单**是一张表格，排版与 DSH 自带的模型选择器一致：每个渠道一行**渠道标题**（如 `WorkBuddy (国际版)`、`LobsterAI (有道)`），下面是该渠道的模型行。表头给出每一列的含义：**模型名称**、**计费倍率**、**上下文窗口**、**来源**。
   - 上下文窗口的单位是token，为了省地方没有专门写在上面，用鼠标悬停提示就能看到。
   - **表头在滚动时固定在上方**
   - **来源**列是最终写进 `chains.json` 的 `provider/model` 标识。
   - **排序有三档**：清单打开时「计费倍率」已按**升序**排好（`↑`，便宜的在前，可以慢慢挑选便宜的模型），点一下变**降序**（`↓`），再点一下进入 `≡` **全局排序**：整个清单变成一条不分渠道的扁平列表，来源列只是信息、不再决定行的位置。第四次点击回到分组升序。「上下文窗口」列同理。价格或窗口查不到的模型在两个方向上都排在最后——翻转排序不会把「未知」顶到真实数字前面。
   - **每个渠道标题可以折叠**：点渠道标题行（左侧有 `▸`/`▾` 记号）即收纳或展开该渠道的模型，折叠只是视图、不写入任何配置；分组下有匹配行时才显示该组。
   - **清单本身可以整块折叠**：点「可用模型清单（N）」那一行（左侧有 `▸`/`▾` 记号）即收起整张表格，选完模型后不再占版面；标题行始终留着，就是展开的入口。折叠只是视图、不写入任何配置。当前编辑的那条链的主模型显示在同一行右侧的「当前主模型：」后面。
   - 清单与候选选择器的可视高度约 12 行（440px / 340px），超出滚动。
   - 搜索框匹配**模型名、渠道名和标识**（例如输入 `kimi` 或 `workbuddy` 都行），不只是标识。
   - 清单直接来自运行中的内核枚举，渠道新增或停用模型后清单会跟着变，不需要改插件代码；上下文窗口查不到时显示「未知」，不会进行编写。
2. 在要当**主模型**的那一行左侧勾选**单选框**，再点搜索框右侧的「**设为回退链主模型**」，即新建一条链。清单顶部若还没有任何链，会显示「还没有配置任何回退链。插件不会干预任何请求，行为与安装前一致。」——**没有链时插件完全不介入**。
   - **同一个主模型可以有多条链**（例如两套候选配置轮换用）。但同一时刻，**同个主模型的链中只有一条能被启用**：启用第二条时，第一条会被自动停用，并弹出一条可关闭的提示。
   - 新建的链会立刻进入编辑状态：管理区多出一行，名字按 `回退链1`、`回退链2`……自动递增，下面是可用模型清单与候选编辑面板。
   - 新建的链三类触发条件**默认全部勾选**（限流 / 服务端错误 / 超时与网络错误），尝试深度默认 3。如果新链默认全部关闭，你可能会以为插件坏了；勾选项就在下面，随时可以关掉不需要的类别。 
3. 点该链上的「**添加候选（勾选即加入）**」，在展开的清单里**勾选**候选模型：勾一个就加入一个，取消勾选就移除——勾选状态本身就是链的内容，所以清单不会和链不一致；已经在链上的候选仍然列出来，否则就没有可取消的勾选框了，并且显示为已勾选。
   - 勾选时**页面不会跑动**：新增的候选行渲染在这张清单的上方，会让清单整体下移；插件会在重排前记下清单的位置，渲染完成后把页面滚回原处，所以鼠标下的勾选框不会溜走。哎我的小巧思，很多插件作者没有留意到这个使用体验问题。
   - 链建好后候选列表也可以收起：点链标题**左侧**的「候选模型（N）」（带 `▸`/`▾` 记号）即收纳该链的候选行，只留链标题——每条链各自独立折叠。折叠记号统一放在左侧，与「可用模型清单」的折叠记号对齐。
4. 用**拖动**（鼠标按住候选前的 `⠿` 图标）或 `↑`/`↓` 按钮调整候选顺序。拖动的作用域**只限本链**，不会影响其它链。顺序在拖放结束的瞬间写入；一次拖动只产生一次顺序写入。
5. 需要时调整该链的**触发条件**（可多选）。粗体是条件，后面的灰字是说明：
   - **限流**——TPM/RPM 或额度用尽，上游返回限流错误、或账号全部在限流中时改派。典型是每分钟 token 用量超限。
   - **服务端错误**——HTTP 5xx，上游返回服务端错误时改派。适合应对服务端临时故障。
   - **超时与网络错误**——请求超时或连接中断时改派。
   取消勾选的类别**不会**触发改派，错误照常报给用户。
插件认的失败码是 `RATE_LIMIT` / `SERVER` / `TIMEOUT` / `TRANSPORT` / `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` / `ACCOUNT_QUOTA`，外加「HTTP 状态 ≥ 500」这一兜底。`QUOTA_EXCEEDED` 按限流处理，是因为「账号全被限流」与「每分钟用量超限」同型——换个账号或模型就能救。反过来，`AUTH` / `INVALID_REQUEST` 这类错误改派也治不了，所以**故意不接**。
6. 设置**尝试深度**：一次失败最多尝试几个候选。用尽后不再重试，直接向用户报告**主模型的原始失败原因**（而不是最后一个候选的错误）。

### 管理已建好的回退链

设置页**最顶部**是一块「**回退链（N）**」清单，**每条链占一行**，这一块就是全部管理入口：名称（没起名字就显示主模型标识）、主模型标识、候选数量与尝试深度，右侧是操作。

- **编辑**——每行右侧的按钮，按下才展开属于这条链的「可用模型清单」与候选编辑面板（再按一次收起）。**同一时刻只会有一条链在编辑**；按下另一行的编辑会替换掉当前面板。折叠与展开都只是视图状态，不会写盘。
- **启用**——取消勾选后这条链**不参与改派**，但它对主模型的配置原样保留；勾回来即恢复。停用的行会变暗。停用一条链与「没有这条链」在运行时完全等价。
- **重命名**——**双击链名**把名称变成输入框，改完按回车或点开别处即保存（按 Esc 取消）。名称只是给人看的标签；链的身份是它自己的 `id`（没起名字就显示主模型标识），所以换名字不影响改派。留空则回落到主模型标识。
- **删除**——第一次点击变成「确认删除」，再点一次才真的删除。这是**两步确认**，毕竟这个删除不能撤销。

**没有链时**，管理区正中有一个「**添加链**」按钮：点它直接建一条空链（主模型待定，名字取下一个 `回退链N`），随后在可用模型清单里给它挑主模型。有链之后，这个按钮挪到管理区标题行右侧。

「可用模型清单」面板标题行右侧的「**当前主模型：**」显示的是**正在编辑的那条链**的主模型（名称、倍率与标识）；链还没挑主模型时显示「尚未选择」，没有链时不显示这一句。

新增链有两条路：管理区里的「**添加链**」（建一条空链再挑主模型），或在可用模型清单里单选 + 「设为回退链主模型」（直接用挑中的模型建链）。

要批量操作也可以直接编辑 `chains.json`。

链数据存在 `<DSH_HOME>/model-fallback/chains.json`。界面不保存自己的副本：每次读取都回到同一份文件，所以别的程序改了它，界面下次读到的就是新顺序。

### 候选不可用时会发生什么

渠道临时停用某个模型时，该候选会**留在链上**并标成橙色「不可用」加原因，**不会被静默删除**。渠道恢复后它自动回到正常呈现，位置和顺序都不变——不需要重新配置。

## 冷却与恢复

- 某个模型调用失败后，会进入**冷却**（默认 60 秒）。冷却期内它**不会被改派选中**，避免把请求反复送进同一个正在出问题的模型。
- 冷却**只影

plugins.description: 控制dsh会话界面显示的模型
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-switchboard

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**模型开关**：在设置页多出一个「模型开关」分区，把 DSH 里所有 provider 和模型摊开，逐个或整组关掉，关掉的模型会从所有模型选择器里消失。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 内置的「Models」设置页只覆盖**在配置里声明过**的 provider。插件动态注册的那批——比如 `dsh-our-free-model` 带来的 `our-free-model`、`our-free-model-region`——在各个选择器里可见，却在内置页面上找不到，于是关不掉。

模型一多，输入框上方的选择器会长得没法看。这个插件补上那一块：

- 设置页「模型开关」列出**运行时段全部** provider 与模型
- **逐模型**开关 + **按 provider 整组**开关
- 关掉的模型立即从所有模型选择器消失——输入框上方、`/model` 弹窗、子代理模型设置，**不用刷新页面**
- 附带 `list_models` 工具：只读列出当前实际生效的模型

## 安装

在 DSH profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖，三种源任选其一：

```json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-model-switchboard": "^0.1.0"
}
```

```json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-model-switchboard": "github:DriverWangNB/dsh-model-switchboard"
}
```

国内网络如果拉 GitHub 不稳，换成 Gitee 镜像（内容同步，同一个包）：

```json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-model-switchboard": "git+https://gitee.com/link77/dsh-models-manager.git"
}
```

依赖的**键**必须是包名 `dsh-model-switchboard`，仓库名与包名一致；pnpm 认的是仓库里 `package.json` 的 `name`。

再把包名登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": [
      "dsh-model-switchboard"
    ]
  }
}
```

然后 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 使用

**设置 → 模型开关**。

| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 点 provider 开关（原本全开） | 整组关闭，组员一起显示关闭 |
| 点 provider 开关（原本整组关闭或部分显示） | 整组全部打开 |
| 点某个组员开关 | 只切换那一个 |
| 在整组关闭的状态下点某个组员 | 该组退出整组关闭，只有这个组员和组是开的 |

provider 开关有三种状态：**显示中**（蓝）、**部分显示**（橙，组里有模型被单独关掉）、**已关闭**。

开关状态存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-model-switchboard/disabled.json`，重启后保留。

> 从旧包名 `dsh-model-manager`（≤0.3.3）升级：状态目录一起改了名，旧的 `~/.dsh/dsh-model-manager/disabled.json` 不会被读取。想保留原来的关闭项，把那个文件复制到新目录即可；不复制就是全部重新打开。

## 工具

| 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `list_models` | 列出运行时段每个 provider 实际生效的模型数，并标出被隐藏的 |
| `dmm_probe` | 自检：插件是否加载、包装了几个 adapter、广播链路是否通 |

## HTTP API

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/dsh-model-switchboard/state` | 当前开关状态与展示数据 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-model-switchboard/toggle` | 切换单个模型或整组 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-model-switchboard/bulk` | 批量切换 |
| POST | `/api/dsh-model-switchboard/reset` | 清空所有关闭项 |

## 工作原理

Host 半身用 `Proxy` 包住 `ctx.llm.adapters` 里每个 registration 的 `adapter`，**只替换 `reg.adapter`**，拦截 `listModels` / `listAllModels` 后按当前状态过滤——原 adapter 一个字节都不改。

这一点很关键：像 channel-pack 这类渠道的 adapter 本身就是 `Proxy`，直接改写它的方法会陷入无限递归（真机上表现为渠道报 `Maximum call stack size exceeded`）。

状态一变，插件广播 `llm/adapters-updated`。客户端的常驻模型目录（`ModelCatalogDirectory`）只在收到这个事件时才重拉；不广播的话，页面会一直用着启动时缓存的那份目录——看起来就像"开关没生效"。

关闭状态**不写进任何 provider 配置**，只影响运行时可见性，因此不会破坏既有配置。

## 开发

```bash
node --test host.test.mjs
```

离线回归测试，用假的 `ctx` / `llm` 覆盖过滤、整组联动、广播，以及 channel-pack 式 `Proxy` 形状。

## 许可

MIT

# 会话花费与余额 · Session Cost

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：在输入框下方查看当前会话的费用估算，点开面板查看用量、账号余额和近期累计。

**版本 0.2.0** · **AGPL-3.0-or-later** · 已在 **macOS / DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2** 验证。

这是独立插件，可以单独安装；[会话标题命名](https://github.com/ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-title-oil) 是另一个可选插件。

## 能做什么

- **会话费用**：根据模型返回的 token 用量与价格表估算，区分输入、输出和缓存用量；未配置价格的模型会标注未计价。
- **费用面板**：点击输入框下方的费用条，查看本会话明细、今日和近 7 天累计；按 Esc 或点击外部关闭。
- **余额与套餐**：管理多个账号，按供应商绑定当前会话，设置后台查询、面板监控和低余额提醒。
- **失败状态可见**：鉴权失败、超时和旧缓存有明确提示；保存失败保留草稿，避免多窗口覆盖配置。

费用数字是估算，供应商账单为准。自动命名等辅助模型调用不在主会话用量里；第三方账号的余额查询也不代表其模型已配置会话计价。

## 安装

### 桌面版：从插件管理器安装（推荐）

1. 打开 DSH 左侧的 **插件 → 添加插件**。
2. 在安装目标中粘贴：

   ```text
   github:ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-session-cost#v0.2.0
   ```

3. 点击安装，完成后选择 **立即启用**。
4. 若管理器提示需要重启，完全退出并重新打开 DSH。插件详情显示「运行中」后，打开任意会话检查费用条。

仓库包含可直接加载的 JavaScript，**不需要构建，也没有安装脚本**。当前通过 GitHub 分发，尚未发布到 npm；不要只输入裸包名。无需手动修改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 bundles。

### 使用 `dsh web` 的用户

只对独立的 `web` profile 使用以下命令；桌面版优先使用上面的插件管理器：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-session-cost#v0.2.0
```

安装后重启已有的 `dsh web` 进程并刷新页面。不同 profile 独立安装；这里的 CLI 语法已对照官方实现，Web 版没有完成与桌面版同等的运行验证。

### 从本地源码安装

```sh
git clone --branch v0.2.0 https://github.com/ygnstudio/dsh-plugin-session-cost.git
cd dsh-plugin-session-cost
pwd
```

将 `pwd` 输出的绝对目录填入 **插件 → 添加插件**。宿主提供 DSH 依赖，不需要在源码目录手动安装一套 DSH。保留该目录，因为本地目录安装可能链接到源码。

## 开始使用

1. 打开 **插件 → 会话花费与余额**，或 **设置 → 费用与账号**。
2. 在「添加账号」中选择类型并填写备注。API key 类型可手动输入，或从 DSH 已有凭据引用导入；本机登录类型从可用登录中选择。
3. 点击 **测试连接**，确认后 **添加**。
4. 在账号卡中设置预警值，选择是否开启 **后台查询** 和 **面板监控**。有多个账号时，在编辑页绑定相应的 DSH 供应商。
5. 回到会话，点击费用条查看面板。账号的 **刷新** 按钮可立即查询。

系统通知需要主动点击「开启系统通知」并在系统中允许。未授权时仍可查看界面内提醒。

### 账号支持范围

| 类型 | 凭据来源 | 显示内容与当前状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek API key | 手动输入或 DSH 凭据引用 | 充值、赠送、合计余额；已实现 |
| DeepSeek 账号 | DSH 的已登录账号服务 | 官方账号余额；已在真实桌面宿主验证 |
| Kimi For Coding | API key | 5 小时与周窗口剩余比例；实验性，未完成真实账号联调 |
| Codex | 当前用户的本机 Codex 登录 | 用量窗口剩余比例；实验性，接口可能变化 |
| WorkBuddy | macOS 本机登录，可识别 WorkDaddy 账号备份 | 积分余额；实验性，依赖客户端版本与本机凭据格式 |
| CodeBuddy | — | 预留项，尚未实现，请勿作为可用适配器使用 |

账号列表每 5 分钟刷新启用后台查询的账号，最多同时查询 2 个。主会话使用的 DSH 官方钱包另按默认 2 分钟间隔刷新。短暂网络失败可保留最近成功读数并标记状态，不能把旧读数当成实时余额。

## 计费与统计说明

- 计价采用 DeepSeek 官方价格表及插件内置回退表。启动与每天尝试更新，打开面板读取本地缓存。
- 未知模型不会套用猜测价格；自定义单价需要配置插件的 `prices`，详见 [实现与接口](docs/architecture.md)。
- 高低峰采用北京时间的普通工作日规则，暂不处理法定节假日调整。
- 今日和近 7 天累计目前只聚合 CNY。账本从插件实际观察到的增量开始记录，不保证补齐安装前的历史费用。
- 旧版中无法确认会话归属的账本记录会保留，但不计入已验证的累计。
- 账号余额变化可能包含其他应用的消费、充值或赠送，不能直接当作某个会话的账单。

## 数据与隐私

默认数据目录：`~/.dsh/plugin-data/session-cost/`；设置了 `DSH_HOME` 时使用其下的 `plugin-data/session-cost/`。

- `accounts.json`：账号设置与最近查询快照。
- `pricing.json`：价格缓存与提示配置。
- `ledger.jsonl`：会话费用增量账本。

目录使用 0700、文件使用 0600 权限。**手动填写的 API key 保存在本机文件中，未额外加密**；从 DSH 导入时优先保存凭据引用。完整 key 不返回界面。

本机登录发现会读取相关应用的账号元数据；WorkBuddy 的加密昵称可能需要启动其本机辅助进程解析。余额查询由 DSH 宿主向所选供应商发送必要凭据；插件没有自建数据收集服务。不要把数据目录、账号配置或完整日志附在公开 Issue 中。

首次升级会复制旧插件目录内的数据并保留原件。源码仓库与安装包均不包含这些运行数据。

## 更新与卸载

- **更新**：备份上面的数据目录，在插件管理器按当前宿主支持的方式更换安装版本。若宿主提示先卸载再安装，使用新版本的 GitHub tag 重新安装；数据目录会保留。
- **停用**：在插件列表关闭开关。
- **卸载**：在插件详情中选择卸载。插件不会自动删除账本和账号数据。
- **Web CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-session-cost`，之后重启对应进程。

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件已安装但费用条没出现 | 确认安装到当前 profile、插件及组件均已启用；查看详情错误，按提示完全重启 |
| 刚开始显示 0 或等待用量 | 等待模型返回 usage；未计价模型需补价格，不代表免费 |
| 余额鉴权失败 | 在相应客户端重新登录，或更新 API key 后测试连接 |
| 当前会话没有匹配账号 | 在账号编辑页检查供应商绑定，并完成一次实际会话调用 |
| 统计与平台账单不同 | 检查辅助调用、价格更新时间、币种及账本开始时间 |
| 多窗口保存冲突 | 保留需要的修改，重新加载最新配置后再保存 |

## 开发与验证

开发测试使用 Node.js 22，无需安装第三方依赖即可运行离线测试：

```sh
npm test
node verify-cost-fold.mjs
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

离线测试使用合成数据，不读取真实凭据，也不调用付费模型。`verify-cost-fold.mjs` 不带参数时只运行内置断言。真实 Host 由 DSH 提供 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 等服务；普通 Node 直接导入 Host 入口不能替代宿主验证。

更多模块、HTTP API、迁移与验证边界见 [实现与接口](docs/architecture.md)。报告问题请附 DSH 版本、操作系统、插件版本、复现步骤和脱敏错误。

## 许可与致谢

[AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE)。参考和改编来源包括 DeepSeek Harness、[dsh-balance-inquiry](https://github.com/Deanyu148/dsh-balance-inquiry) 与 [WorkDaddy](https://github.com/babygoton/WorkDaddy)。各来源的范围、版权与许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。本项目并非这些产品的官方插件。

# dsh-session-intent-title

English | [中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

An independent, zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that automatically classifies new conversation intents and names sessions with clean prefixes (e.g., `⚡ 优化｜...`, `🐛 修复｜...`, `✨ 功能｜...`).

## ✨ Features

- **🎯 Automatic Intent Classification**: Evaluates the first user message using lightweight LLM prompts to detect task intent and extract concise subjects.
- **🛡️ Zero UI Invasion**: Pure backend logic provider. Does not inject any frontend CSS, sidebar overrides, or custom themes. Perfectly compatible with `dsh-better-sidebar` and native DSH Web UI.
- **🔒 Safe & Non-Intrusive**: Only triggers once on the first turn. Any manual renaming by the user immediately locks and will never be overwritten.

## 📋 Intent Categories

| Type | Prefix & Emoji | Example Generated Title |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`optimize`** | `⚡ 优化｜...` | `⚡ 优化｜提升循环性能与内存占用` |
| **`fix`** | `🐛 修复｜...` | `🐛 修复｜排查登录接口401问题` |
| **`feature`** | `✨ 功能｜...` | `✨ 功能｜实现OAuth2鉴权模块` |
| **`explore`** | `🔍 探索｜...` | `🔍 探索｜调研WebAssembly在前端的应用` |
| **`design`** | `🎨 设计｜...` | `🎨 设计｜深模块架构重构方案` |
| **`research`** | `🔬 研究｜...` | `🔬 研究｜多智能体协作框架评测` |
| **`docs`** | `📝 文档｜...` | `📝 文档｜编写API使用说明与规范` |
| **`release`** | `🚀 发布｜...` | `🚀 发布｜打包Docker镜像与部署上线` |

## 🚀 Installation

### 1. Install via DSH CLI

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/WiseXin/dsh-session-intent-title.git
```

### 2. Disable default unclassified title provider

In `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, disable the official unclassified provider:

```yaml
- id: session-title-llm
  disabled: true
```

### 3. Restart DSH

```bash
sudo systemctl restart dsh
```

## 📄 License
